scripts.build: npm run build:sdk && npm run build:indexer
scripts.derive:addresses: npm run build:sdk --silent && node --import tsx scripts/derive-addresses.mts
scripts.replay: npm run build --silent && node --import tsx scripts/replay-agreement.mts
scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run test:sdk && npm run test:indexer && npm run test:release
scripts.test:indexer: npm run build:sdk && npm run test --workspace @gwap/ppv-indexer
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && npm run typecheck --workspace @gwap/ppv-sdk && npm run build:sdk && npm run typecheck --workspace @gwap/ppv-indexer && npm run build:indexer && tsc --noEmit -p scripts/tsconfig.json
